source_event.reason: The independent audit rejected release because the branch advanced materially beyond the certified handoff while the stale certificate remained present.

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A workflow can publish a material change after a valid handoff and still surface a successful terminal state unless final success rechecks material identity, certificate identity, parentage and changed-path policy.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat successful CI or a previously ready certificate as sufficient after a material write, without proving that the final head is a direct allowlisted results child of the current material head.

reusable_control.rule: Block terminal success after any material write until certificate material identity, final head parent and final changed paths prove a direct allowlisted result-only handoff child.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: A workflow that writes materially after handoff must enter recertification and cannot finish green or audit-ready until a new terminal handoff exists.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: The final-state latch compares expected material identity, certificate material identity, final head parent and changed paths; any mismatch blocks success.

transfer_cases.scenario: A test or formatting fix creates a new material head after a previously valid handoff certificate.
An auxiliary workflow appends a non-allowlisted material path after the results-only child.
